title: Shenzhen PDF Reader — Free native PDF reader for Mac
description: Shenzhen PDF Reader (ShenzhenPDF) is a free, open-source Mac PDF reader with document groups, Markdown and EPUB support, local version history, OCR and offline translation.
lede: A fast PDF reader for Mac, with room for all your documents. Read PDFs, Markdown, EPUB and images in one workspace, organized the way you think.
requirements: Apple Silicon · macOS 12 or later · Signed & notarized
screenshot_alt: Shenzhen PDF Reader on macOS showing a PDF, highlighted search matches and the document map
caption: Search in context. Jump through the document map. Keep your place across sessions.
feature1: Type to search in your document. See matches with context, use the document map to jump between pages, or press ⌘K to find another file.
feature2: Organize documents into colored groups. Tabs, groups and reading positions return when you reopen the app. Create an empty group for your next project.
feature3: Collection keeps local copies and version history. OCR and translation run on your machine; the tools and language models need an initial download.
workspace: Keep datasheets, research papers, notes and manuals together. Switch between groups, search their document names, and bring the current document into view without losing your place.
groups_alt: Shenzhen PDF Reader with colored document groups and a compact sidebar
formats_description: Open e-books, Markdown notes, source files and pictures. Markdown is paginated, code gets syntax highlighting, and HTML opens as source code.
a1: Yes. ShenzhenPDF is free and open source. The source code, licenses and release history are available on GitHub. No account is required to read your documents.
a2: Reading, Collection history, OCR and translation are local. Optional tools and models are downloaded when needed, and update checks contact GitHub. Documents can themselves contain remote content, such as linked images in Markdown.
a3: The download above is the signed, notarized macOS app for Apple Silicon. A GTK4 Linux frontend is also available in the project. The Windows frontend is in development and has no published binary.
q4: Can an AI agent control the reader?
a4: Yes. The documented local API and MCP interface let agents open documents, inspect pages, organize tab groups and control Markdown layout.
download_info: Get the latest stable ShenzhenPDF release directly from GitHub.
footer: Shenzhen PDF Reader is also known as ShenzhenPDF. Inspired by SumatraPDF; a separate project, not affiliated with it. This website uses no analytics or third-party fonts.
